title: The Compatibility of Astragali Radix and Angelicae Sinensis Radix Attenuates Atherosclerosis by Suppressing Vascular Endothelial PANoptosis via the p38 MAPK/p53 Pathway: A Multi-Omics and Experimental Study.
authors: Li, Wanyu; Long, Qingyin; Fu, Xinying; Li, Yanling; Ma, Lu; Tan, Wei; Hu, Zhongji; Zhang, Yanyan; She, Yan; Zhang, Wei; Deng, Changqing
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨中药配伍通过p38MAPK/p53通路抑制血管内皮PANoptosis抗动脉粥样硬化，核心为细胞程序性死亡与信号通路，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Previous studies have reported that the combination of Astragali Radix and Angelicae Sinensis Radix (AR-ASR) can ameliorate atherosclerosis (AS) through anti-inflammatory effects; however, the exact mechanistic underpinnings still await further clarification. The present study investigates the anti-atherosclerotic action of AR-ASR from the perspective of PANoptosis (encompassing apoptosis, pyroptosis, and necroptosis). To ascertain the chief active ingredients of the AR plus ASR mixture, UPLC-MS/MS detection was utilized. To predict potential therapeutic targets, a multi-faceted bioinformatics strategy was applied, integrating transcriptomics, single-cell sequencing, network pharmacology, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations. In vivo, male ApoE-deficient mice were allocated at random into the model cohort, AR-ASR low-, medium-, and high-dose groups (AR-ASR L, AR-ASR M, and AR-ASR H, respectively), atorvastatin group (ATV), and control group (age-matched wild-type C57BL/6J mice). Atherosclerosis was induced by 12 weeks of high-fat diet feeding, followed by 4 weeks of oral gavage treatment. Assessment parameters included aortic intimal hyperplasia thickness, serum lipid levels, vascular inflammatory factor expression, endothelial function, and the gene and protein expression levels of PANoptosis- and p38MAPK/p53 signaling pathway-related molecules. For in vitro experiments, POVPC-stimulated AVECs were used as an oxidative damage model and then treated with AR-ASR-containing serum. Cell proliferation activity, cell injury rate, and the expression levels of PANoptosis markers and p38MAPK/p53 signaling pathway-related molecules were measured. Furthermore, in the presence of a p38MAPK agonist, the protective effect of AR-ASR on AVECs and its underlying mechanism were investigated. Bioinformatics analysis suggested that AR-ASR modulates PANoptosis and interferes with AS via the p38MAPK/p53 signaling axis. In vivo, AR-ASR treatment reduced serum lipid levels, attenuated aortic intimal hyperplasia, decreased plasma inflammatory cytokine levels and vascular inflammatory factor expression, improved endothelial function, and suppressed both vascular PANoptosis and p38MAPK/p53 pathway activation. In vitro, POVPC induced oxidative damage and PANoptosis in AVECs. AR-ASR-containing serum promoted AVEC viability, reduced LDH release, inhibited the expression of PANoptosis-related markers, and downregulated p38MAPK/p53 signaling pathway protein expression. Furthermore, in the presence of a p38MAPK agonist, the inhibitory effects of AR-ASR on cellular PANoptosis and p38MAPK/p53 pathway activation were significantly attenuated. The AR-ASR compatibility suppresses p38MAPK/p53 pathway activation, thereby inhibiting vascular endothelial PANoptosis-driven inflammatory responses and ameliorating atherosclerotic vascular pathology.
abstract_zh: 既往研究报道，黄芪-当归药对（AR-ASR）可通过抗炎作用改善动脉粥样硬化（AS），但其确切机制仍有待进一步阐明。本研究从PANoptosis（涵盖凋亡、焦亡和坏死性凋亡）的角度探讨AR-ASR的抗动脉粥样硬化作用。为确定AR与ASR混合物的主要活性成分，采用了UPLC-MS/MS检测。为预测潜在治疗靶点，应用了整合转录组学、单细胞测序、网络药理学、分子对接和分子动力学模拟的多层面生物信息学策略。在体内实验中，雄性ApoE缺陷小鼠被随机分为模型组、AR-ASR低、中、高剂量组（分别为AR-ASR L、AR-ASR M和AR-ASR H）、阿托伐他汀组（ATV）和对照组（年龄匹配的野生型C57BL/6J小鼠）。通过12周高脂饮食喂养诱导动脉粥样硬化，随后进行4周口服灌胃治疗。评估参数包括主动脉内膜增生厚度、血清脂质水平、血管炎症因子表达、内皮功能，以及PANoptosis和p38MAPK/p53信号通路相关分子的基因和蛋白表达水平。在体外实验中，使用POVPC刺激的AVECs作为氧化损伤模型，然后用含AR-ASR血清处理。测量了细胞增殖活性、细胞损伤率，以及PANoptosis标志物和p38MAPK/p53信号通路相关分子的表达水平。此外，在p38MAPK激动剂存在下，研究了AR-ASR对AVECs的保护作用及其潜在机制。生物信息学分析提示，AR-ASR通过p38MAPK/p53信号轴调节PANoptosis并干预AS。在体内，AR-ASR治疗降低了血清脂质水平，减轻了主动脉内膜增生，降低了血浆炎症细胞因子水平和血管炎症因子表达，改善了内皮功能，并抑制了血管PANoptosis和p38MAPK/p53通路激活。在体外，POVPC诱导AVECs发生氧化损伤和PANoptosis。含AR-ASR血清促进了AVEC活力，减少了LDH释放，抑制了PANoptosis相关标志物的表达，并下调了p38MAPK/p53信号通路蛋白表达。此外，在p38MAPK激动剂存在下，AR-ASR对细胞PANoptosis和p38MAPK/p53通路激活的抑制作用显著减弱。AR-ASR配伍通过抑制p38MAPK/p53通路激活，从而抑制血管内皮PANoptosis驱动的炎症反应，改善动脉粥样硬化血管病理。
